text:
harry_lin: Heads-up  Prospect (AtlasBank) asked if we can support an air-gapped pilot with two unusual constraints: they want pre-signed deltas deposited into their internal secrets vault (so operations pulls approved artifacts), and they want a time-locked release window in the SOW (we only allow applies within N-day approved window). Also they want clear per-site multi-year pricing and an emergency rollback SLA.

zoe_morales: Yes to vaulted pre-signed artifacts. We can export manifest.sig and tarball.sig and give a timestamped package that they can import. Important caveat: once artifacts are time-locked in their vault we can't rotate signatures for that blob without issuing a new bundle. Need to surface that in procurement.

devon_cho: Ops notes / constraints:
- apply command on-site: `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /media/usb/manifest.json --verify --vault-check`
- `--vault-check` will validate the manifest.sig against a timestamped issuance ledger we produce and the customer's vault metadata (e.g., artifact ID + TTL).
- Agent minimum for vault-integrated apply = 2.9.0 (supports ledger verification).
- delta efficiency still depends on shard layout; some custom quantized shards will require full replacement.

eng-sales-bot: POC ticket created: POC-42077 assigned devon_cho. https://app.redwood/POC-42077

security_louise: Pre-SOW security items to confirm with AtlasBank: preferred vault import format (JWK/PEM), whether they want Redwood to sign or prefer customer HSM signing, SBOM acceptance format, and confirmation of telemetry opt-out. Also need to confirm if time-locked TTLs must be enforced by Redwood packaging.

zoe_morales: Pricing guidance for the sales deck (ballpark): baseline vaulted-offline = $19k/yr/site (includes signed packaging, one quarterly pre-signed delta, custody ledger). Time-locked monthly cadence = +$9k/yr/site. Vault-integration & HSM support = +$5k/yr/site. Emergency rollback SLA (24h) = +$6k/yr/site or $7k/event for ad-hoc. Multi-year discounts: 2-year = 8% off, 3-year = 15% off.

harry_lin: Procurement specifically asked for SOW language that locks apply windows (e.g., "applies executed only within 7-day approved window after artifacts are released"). Contracts also asked whether we support a scheduled "pre-staging" window where artifacts are deposited but flagged as "do-not-apply" until the window opens.

contracts_ana: We can draft two SOW options: (A) Redwood-managed issuance: Redwood issues signed artifacts and guarantees issuance timestamps and custody logs; we take standard liability cap. (B) Customer-vaulted: customer imports pre-signed artifacts into their vault and accepts responsibility for storage; Redwood provides signing proof and a custody ledger but limits liability for later tampering. I'll prepare both clauses. Need customer's legal contact.

devon_cho: Demo manifest snippet we'll use on the kickoff (trimmed):
```
{
  "manifest_version":"2",
  "site":"atlasbank-poc",
  "bundles":["runtime-5.0.zst","models/secure-gptq-v3"],
  "delta":true,
  "vault_artifact_id":"atlas-2026-03-15-001",
  "issuance_ts":"2026-03-15T18:00:00Z",
  "sig":"MEUCIQ..."
}
```

security_louise: Also add item: they asked for an "issuance ledger" PDF that shows signer identity, build CI id, checksums, and a QR link to a verification endpoint we host. We'll produce that and a short playbook for vault import.

harry_lin: Plan: 30m kickoff Thurs 10am CET. Agenda: demo vault-import & `redwood-offline-apply --vault-check`, show issuance ledger & custody PDF, discuss time-locked windows and pricing tiers, and review SOW options. Can everyone make it?

zoe_morales: Ill prepare the pricing slide and sample SOW bullets.

devon_cho: Ill build a small pre-signed delta + issuance ledger for the demo and upload to staging. ETA: Wed EOD.

contracts_ana: Ill draft the two SOW options and the liability language; will drop before the call.

harry_lin: Great  if AtlasBank can share their vault import docs (JWK endpoint or PEM) before the call we can simulate end-to-end. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
